entities.name: PC5-RRC connection
entities.description: Connection established for PC5 sidelink communication between UEs, associated with a PC5 unicast link.

entities.name: SL-SRB0
entities.description: Sidelink Signaling Radio Bearer 0 used to transmit PC5-S messages before PC5-S security establishment.

entities.name: SL-SRB1
entities.description: Sidelink Signaling Radio Bearer 1 used to transmit PC5-S messages to establish PC5-S security.

entities.name: SL-SRB2
entities.description: Sidelink Signaling Radio Bearer 2 used to transmit protected PC5-S messages after PC5-S security establishment.

entities.name: SL-SRB3
entities.description: Sidelink Signaling Radio Bearer 3 used to transmit protected PC5-RRC signalling after PC5-S security establishment.

entities.name: SL-SRB4
entities.description: Sidelink Signaling Radio Bearer 4 used to transmit/receive NR sidelink discovery messages for U2N Relay operation.

entities.name: SL-DRB
entities.description: Sidelink Data Radio Bearer used for user data transmission in NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: AS security
entities.description: Access Stratum security comprising integrity protection and ciphering for PC5 signalling and user data.

entities.name: PC5 unicast link
entities.description: Unicast link established between UEs for sidelink communication, with one-to-one correspondence to PC5-RRC connection.

entities.name: Key change indication
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate a change of security key, triggering PDCP re-establishment.

entities.name: Integrity check failure
entities.description: Condition where integrity check failure is detected for SL-SRB1, triggering indication to upper layers.

relations.description: PC5-RRC connection uses SL-SRB0 for pre-security PC5-S message transmission.
PC5-RRC connection uses SL-SRB1 for PC5-S security establishment messages.
PC5-RRC connection uses SL-SRB2 for protected PC5-S messages after security establishment.
PC5-RRC connection uses SL-SRB3 for protected PC5-RRC signalling after security establishment.
PC5-RRC connection uses SL-DRBs for user data transmission.
AS security provides integrity protection for SL-SRB1.
AS security provides integrity protection for SL-SRB2.
AS security provides integrity protection for SL-SRB3.
AS security provides integrity protection for SL-DRBs.
AS security provides ciphering for SL-SRB1 (for Direct Link Security Mode Complete message).
AS security provides ciphering for SL-SRB2.
AS security provides ciphering for SL-SRB3.
AS security provides ciphering for SL-DRBs.
Key change indication from upper layers triggers PDCP re-establishment for SL-SRB1, SL-SRB2, SL-SRB3 and SL-DRBs.
Integrity check failure for SL-SRB1 triggers indication to upper layers.
PC5 unicast link has one-to-one correspondence with PC5-RRC connection.
